notice.closed: Day closed. The record is below — see you tomorrow.
notice.acknowledgeRequired: Acknowledge the open boat or head count before closing the day.
notice.recapAttention: Some recaps need attention. Check the post-dive reports below.
notice.recapNotReady: Recaps cannot be sent until four hours after the departure ends.
notice.recapLocked: This recap has been sent. Its note and photos can no longer be changed.
notice.crewPhotoAdded: Crew photo added to this close-out.
notice.crewPhotoLimit: This close-out already has the maximum number of crew photos.
notice.crewPhotoUnsupported: Photo uploads are not configured for this shop yet.
notice.crewPhotoFailed: That photo could not be added. Check the file and try again.

headline.outstanding: A few things are still open
headline.noDepartures: A quiet day at the dock

subtitle.allClear: Every head count on today's boats closed clean and nothing from today is still waiting. Close the day and go home.
subtitle.outstanding: A few things are still open from today. Settle what you can, decide about the rest — the close records your choices.
subtitle.noDepartures: No boat sailed today. Have a look at what tomorrow opens with, close the day, and go home.
subtitle.closedSoFar: The day is closed. Nothing locks — anything below can still be acted on, and closing again adds another record.

departures.heading: How today's boats ended
departures.subtitle: Every departure of the day, judged by its head count — the same evidence the manifest and Today chase.

detail.allHome: {booked, plural, =0 {Nobody was booked} one {# diver, head count closed} other {# divers, head count closed}}.
detail.stillOut: Due back at {time}. A boat that is not home cannot read as closed.
detail.missingDiver: {count, plural, one {# diver was marked not back aboard after dive {dive}.} other {# divers were marked not back aboard after dive {dive}.}} Find them — the count closes on the manifest.
detail.missingCrew: {count, plural, one {# crew member was marked not back aboard after dive {dive}.} other {# crew members were marked not back aboard after dive {dive}.}} Find them — the count closes on the manifest.
detail.afterDiveUncounted: {count, plural, one {# diver has no result after dive {dive}.} other {# divers have no result after dive {dive}.}} The count was never closed.
detail.crewUncounted: {count, plural, one {# crew member has no result after dive {dive}.} other {# crew members have no result after dive {dive}.}} The count was never closed.
detail.departureUncounted: {count, plural, one {The dock count never finished — # diver has no result at departure.} other {The dock count never finished — # divers have no result at departure.}}
detail.noRollCall: No roll call was recorded on this trip.

admin.heading: Administrative close-out
admin.subtitle: Follow-up work for the boats that are already back.

postDiveReports.label: Post-dive reports
postDiveReports.description: Send each diver the recap from a completed departure.
postDiveReports.pending: {count, plural, one {# report is still queued.} other {# reports are still queued.}}
postDiveReports.failed: {count, plural, one {# report needs attention.} other {# reports need attention.}}

recap.ready: This departure's recaps can now be sent. Automatic sending will also pick them up.
recap.sent: This recap was sent at {time}. The note and photos are now locked.

crewPhotos.heading: Crew photos
crewPhotos.description: Photos here are shared with every diver in this departure's recap.
crewPhotos.confirmRemove: Remove this crew photo from the close-out?

leftovers.heading: Today's leftovers
leftovers.subtitle: Open work from today. Carry it into tomorrow or dismiss it — the close-out remembers either choice.
leftovers.empty: Nothing is left over from today.

tomorrow.heading: Tomorrow, at a glance
tomorrow.subtitle: What the morning queue opens with — read it now, walk out lighter.
tomorrow.count: {count, plural, one {# job is waiting in tomorrow's queue.} other {# jobs are waiting in tomorrow's queue.}}

close.heading: Close the day
close.acknowledge: {count, plural, one {# boat above is still out or has an open head count. I have seen it — closing the day does not stop the chase.} other {# boats above are still out or have open head counts. I have seen them — closing the day does not stop the chase.}}
close.note: Closing is a record, not a lock: who closed, when, and what was still open. Nothing downstream waits on it.

record.heading: Day closed
